Charlie Kirk on France, 11 years ago:
It costs $0.00 to be a kind man.

Just wanted to share, the leaked XP NT 5.1 kernel + Linux shim xfce4, now has got Chromium up and running.

The chromium supports headless and normal GUI modes, it’s convenient to be used as a coding AI agentic VM cage.

No GPU support, uses SwiftShader, 100% fits the VM jail/cage usage.

Chromium is pre-built, patches to rebuild are included in the tree.

https://github.com/merckhung/nt51_xfce4_embedded
